_doc: Task 61d, read by TownDrama: at world creation the town gets a random handful of stories already running, rolled from the world seed (never hand-written families), each a real state in an existing system as if it had been going for a while. After the seed nothing is scripted: the usual systems (discovery, gossip, fights, cases, autonomy, chance) run it. count = [min, max] per 40 adult townies (scaled by town size, clamped to clamp). weights = how often each kind is rolled; rough_mult = the weight multiplier when the people involved live in a rough district (never by heritage). ledger = the life-summary line when the player gets involved with someone in the thread ({who} = the person the player got close to, {a} and {b} = the two people in the thread).

ledger.feud: Got to know {who}, in the middle of the feud between {a} and {b}.
ledger.affair: Got close to {who}, in the middle of {a}'s affair with {b}.
ledger.secret: Got close to {who}, around a secret of {a}'s that {b} already knew.
ledger.debt: Got to know {who}, around {a}'s overdue debt to {b}.
ledger.crew: Got to know {a}, who runs with a crew.
ledger.cold_case: Got to know {who}, around the old break-in at {b}'s that {a} was never caught for.
ledger.business: Got to know {a}, whose business was struggling.
ledger.family: Got to know {who}, around the rift between {a} and {b}.
ledger.addiction: Got to know {a}, who was using.
ledger.tension: Got close to {who}, around what was going on between {a} and {b}.
